Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Management reported a standalone revenue from operations of ₹ 1,173.25 Lakhs and a standalone net profit of ₹ 3,753.55 Lakhs for the financial year ended 31st March, 2026. The consolidated revenues from operations increased to ₹ 11,642.04 Lakhs, with a consolidated net profit of ₹ 6,853.79 Lakhs. The Board decided to retain current year profits to support planned capital expenditures and did not recommend any dividend. Additionally, the company incorporated Beluga International (IFSC) Private Limited in GIFT City as a wholly owned subsidiary to undertake ship leasing. Dolphin Offshore Enterprises (India) Limited held its 46th Annual General Meeting on August 30, 2025, and submitted its Annual Report for the financial year 2024-25.

demand_outlook.claim: Global offshore oil and gas activity continues to strengthen, supported by sustained investments in energy security, increasing deepwater developments, and the need to offset production declines from mature fields.
demand_outlook.quote: Global offshore oil and gas activity continues to strengthen, supported by sustained investments in energy security, increasing deepwater developments, and the need to offset production declines from mature fields.

demand_outlook.claim: The offshore support vessel market remains in an upcycle driven by higher offshore capital expenditure, improving utilization levels and constrained vessel supply.
demand_outlook.quote: The offshore support vessel market remains in an upcycle driven by higher offshore capital expenditure, improving utilization levels and constrained vessel supply.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for Anchor Handling Tug Supply (AHTS), Platform Supply Vessels (PSVs), Diving Support Vessels (DSVs) and Multi-Purpose Support Vessels (MPSVs) continues to improve across major offshore basins.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand for Anchor Handling Tug Supply (AHTS), Platform Supply Vessels (PSVs), Diving Support Vessels (DSVs) and Multi-Purpose Support Vessels (MPSVs) continues to improve across major offshore basins.

demand_outlook.claim: Platform Supply Vessels (PSVs) are currently in high demand due to increased activity on offshore oil and gas platforms.
demand_outlook.quote: Platform Supply Vessels (PSVs) are currently in high demand due to increased activity on offshore oil and gas platforms.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that PSVs are in high demand following robust activities on offshore platforms.
demand_outlook.quote: PSV are in high demand following robust activities on offshore platforms.

capex_expansion.claim: Dolphin Offshore Enterprises (India) Limited is planning for acquiring new vessels depending on the proximity of contract.
capex_expansion.quote: In response to this market opportunity, Dolphin Offshore Enterprises (India) Limited is planning for acquiring new vessels depending on the proximity of contract.

capex_expansion.claim: Beluga International DMCC, a wholly owned subsidiary, owns the DP2 Accommodation Work Barge Prabha.
capex_expansion.quote: Prabha is a Dynamically Positioned Vessel (DP2) accommodation Work Barge with a capacity of 275 People, Deck Space of 1200 sq. meter and 450 ton crore and the same is owned by Beluga International DMCC.

capital_allocation.claim: The board proposed a special resolution to advance loans, give guarantees, or provide security up to an aggregate sum of Rs. 300 Crores.
capital_allocation.quote: upto an aggregate sum of ` 300 Crores (Rupees Three Hundred Crores Only) in their absolute discretion deem beneficial and in the interest of the Company, provided that such loans are utilized by the borrower companies for its principal business activities.

risks_headwinds.claim: Fluctuations in oil prices can lead to reduced demand for vessels, affecting profitability.
risks_headwinds.quote: Volatility in Oil Prices: Offshore vessels heavily rely on the oil and gas industry. Fluctuations in oil prices can lead to reduced demand for vessels, affecting profitability.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global economic slowdowns can lead to reduced investment in offshore projects, leading to lower utilization rates for offshore vessels.
risks_headwinds.quote: Economic Downturns: Global economic slowdowns can lead to reduced investment in offshore projects, leading to lower utilization rates for offshore vessels.

risks_headwinds.claim: Collisions, groundings, or accidents can result in significant financial losses and environmental damage.
risks_headwinds.quote: Accidents and Collisions: Offshore operations are complex and hazardous. Collisions, groundings, or accidents can result in significant financial losses and environmental damage.

risks_headwinds.claim: Vessels operating in certain regions may face the threat of piracy or armed attacks, leading to potential loss of assets and crew.
risks_headwinds.quote: Piracy and Armed Attacks: Vessels operating in certain regions may face the threat of piracy or armed attacks, leading to potential loss of assets and crew.

risks_headwinds.claim: Increasing digitalization of vessel operations raises the risk of cyber-attacks, which could disrupt operations or lead to data breaches.
risks_headwinds.quote: Cybersecurity: Increasing digitalization of vessel operations raises the risk of cyber-attacks, which could disruptoperations or lead to data breaches.

risks_headwinds.claim: Specialized subsea engineering, diving services, and vessel operations require highly certified personnel, and a domestic shortage could drive up operating costs or stall execution timelines.
risks_headwinds.quote: Shortage of Skilled Maritime Crew and Divers: Specialized subsea engineering, diving services, and vessel operations require highly certified personnel. Wage inflation or a domestic shortage of qualified marine crew and commercial divers could drive up operating costs or stall execution timelines.

management_commitments.claim: Management proposed transactions with Deep Onshore Services Private Limited for the financial years 2024-25 till 2026-27.
management_commitments.quote: Approval of the Board is being sought for transactions during the Three (3) Financial years (i.e. from 2024-25 till Financial Year 2026-27)
